notes: Fixed hexagonal layout overlap bug: hexSizeMultiplier scaled the hexagon radius R but not the grid spacing R_eff used for center positions, causing hexagons to overlap at large multipliers. Fix: introduced R_grid = R_eff * hexSizeMultiplier for center position computation. Added tests 1.8.15 (no overlap at 2x multiplier via center-distance check) and 1.8.16 (center distance scales proportionally with multiplier).
